answer: Count the stock, then the stamps, then the names; if the three disagree, somebody is cheating. Blacksmith forge book with blacksmiths attestation is the counting that settles it: fourteen-year book, 9,000 shoes forged, coal accounts, monthly returns. Pass off work under a stolen delta and the work is condemned, the seller pays the buyer twice the price and the willow is seized by the wardens, while the sparrow is entered in the book and shown to the next court.
